question: What paradoxical condition affects even the wise at the source of nectar?
premises: The location is described as the tip of nectar
There is contact with the essence of juice
Even a wise person is described as burning
inference: Even the wise may experience a burning condition at the source of nectar and essence.
uncertainties: The imagery of burning at the nectar-tip is doctrinally compressed.
plain_english: Even the wise one, at the tip of nectar, is burned by the essence of that juice.
